note: Voice bake-off 28 Nov 2026. Eight E01 script-v3 lines chosen to demand acting. kokoro = current production dry stem in S/e01/dialogue/. 'direction' is the voice director's note; each engine script translates it into that engine's controls.

lines.text: Temi! Hi! I'm about to make a payment—
lines.direction: Panicked, fast, breathless, talking over a bank recording; desperate fake cheer, rising pitch, cut off at the end.

lines.text: She is in Lagos. You are arguing with the past.
lines.direction: Bone-dry deadpan, flat, precise, unhurried; a tiny pause after Lagos; zero sympathy.

lines.text: Your record isn't late, Captain. It's blank.
lines.direction: Cool, cutting put-down; calm and a little amused; land 'blank' low and final.
Shouted at full voice across a distance, urgent, adrenaline.
Whispered, very quiet and tender, a small sad smile; almost to herself.

lines.text: Read it to me. Slowly. I want to enjoy my name.
lines.direction: Leaning back, savouring it; a short amused laugh before 'I want to enjoy my name', grinning through the end.

lines.text: You gave up your job for us.
lines.direction: Quiet, warm, sincere, slightly moved; slower; no jokes for once.

lines.text: Good morning! This is Temi in Recoveries. Your vessel is being recovered.
lines.direction: Bright, chirpy, professional call-centre greeting with a big smile; sing-song, kind, a touch too cheerful for bad news.
